newsitem.title: JAPAN: Nissan, Ford to end vehicle tie-up in Europe - paper.
newsitem.headline: Nissan, Ford to end vehicle tie-up in Europe - paper.

text.p: Nissan Motor Co will terminate its tie-up with Ford Motor Co in Europe by not renewing their current arrangement on the production of recreational vehicles (RVs) in Spain, a Japanese newspaper said.
The Nihon Keizai Shimbun said on Sunday that the current agreement would expire at the end of 1998.
The paper said the two originally set up the partnership to complement each other's recreational vehicle business in Europe, but they now felt that they could go it alone.
Nissan and Ford will continue their minivan venture in the United States, it said.
A Nissan spokesman said he was checking on the report and could not comment at this time.
